name: govisit-local-business
description: Find and inspect business profiles and their local destination context. Place updates are planned.

interface.longDescription: Find a business and inspect its published GoVisit profile, visit facts, related places, and destination context. Includes 10 public read skills for local businesses and requires no GoVisit API key. Reading a profile does not establish ownership or live availability. Place updates are planned; this package cannot publish edits or make reservations.
